clues.name: Round Sunglasses
clues.subtitle: Can't block light or the sun, merely decorative.
clues.text: Fine white scuffs line the edges of the metal frame. A strip of faded medical tape clings to the nose pads, and a faint ring of dark red marks traces the rim of the lenses. These sunglasses have clearly been with Gregory for a long time. Even so, whenever he meets a client, he carefully tidies them up, hiding those less-than-presentable details. It's the most basic form of respect a merchant can show in a deal.

clues.name: Flask
clues.subtitle: Whatever it holds, it always carries a taste of home.
clues.text: The surface is coated with matte black paint, and the stainless steel seams of the inner lining leak, causing winding trails to flow down the flask every time a drink is poured, no matter how carefully. The cap is attached with plastic, which has lost its elasticity. This is a flask Gregory casually bought when he left Ovett by boat, and now it is one of the few items from his homeland that remains by his side.

clues.name: Gold Ring
clues.subtitle: Roughly made, kept only as a memento.
clues.text: The gold ring has developed a patina over the years from being rubbed, with a small piece of tinplate fixed to the ring face by rivets. The edges have been polished multiple times to keep them smooth, but it always seems to catch some unknown debris when worn. By conventional standards, its craftsmanship is a disaster, but don't say that in front of Gregory—after all, he crafted it himself to commemorate his hometown.

clues.name: Cowboy Hat
clues.subtitle: Looks brand new, showing no trace of time or battle.
clues.text: A black cowboy hat made of high-quality matte leather, with a moderately wide brim and evenly patinated edges. The crown is slightly indented, and the inner leather sweatband is spotless. Despite being worn for six years, it has been well-maintained by Garcia. However, very few people know that this hat originally belonged to his enemy—a deputy leader of a gang that once led an attack on Port Kadrey. He was riddled with bullets by Garcia, yet the hat on his head didn't even have a bullet hole. Those in the underworld never mind believing in some unusual things, and Garcia is no exception. So he kept this hat, hoping that one day, when he has to face death, it will also protect its new owner from dying in a disfigured state.

clues.name: Gold Watch
clues.subtitle: Only the surface is gold.
clues.text: The round case of the watch is covered in gold, with slight wear from use on the surface, and the edges and corners have a slightly faded plating. The watch on Garcia's left hand appears to be valuable, but in reality, it is just an ordinary mechanical watch plated with gold. However, he still treasures it—when he was young, he mistakenly believed it was extremely valuable and could help him cover his mother's medical expenses. He risked his life to snatch it from the Enemy Leader, getting shot in the process. Garcia keeps it with him to this day as a reminder not to make the same mistake again.

clues.name: Milkhaman Eagle
clues.subtitle: This time, it will be aimed at former comrades.
clues.text: A large-caliber handgun from the New Gold Rush era, cherished by gun lovers for its raw power and iconic design. A gift from Genovese at their first meeting, it remains Garcia's beloved weapon to this day. Garcia has lost count of how many family foes this gun has vanquished, or how many times it has helped him escape death... He also doesn't know how many bullets he'll have to fire at his former comrades next.
